rules: felt>=0.167, rail>=0.317 per placement (metrics.measure vs holes.json solids); walk corridors kept clear; no overlap between new instances

edgefix.rule: true mesh gap>=0.086 and 0 coplanar tri pairs vs all dressing neighbours; felt>=0.167 rail>=0.317

edgefix2.rule: felt>=0.15, rail>=0.30; every neighbour pair true mesh gap>=0.086 and 0 coplanar tri pairs

edgefix3.rule: fills: same piece scaled in x/z (y=1) + small shift, gap>=0.086 to all neighbours, 0 coplanar, felt>=0.15 rail>=0.30

edgefix4.rule: filler rocks (Strata) in openings, gap>=0.086 to all, 0 coplanar, felt>=0.15, rail>=0.30

v49fix.rules: no piece footprint over felt (2D), >=1 stud plan distance to rails, else deleted; floaters lowered gap+0.12; flagged flush pieces sunk >=0.1 with 0 coplanar; fillers removed (buried under terrain)

thin60.rule: deleted dressing whose plan position is >60 studs from every hole felt (cliffT/clay_brick_edging exempt), heaviest LOD pieces first, alternate instances

h1_tee_estimate_M.model: 0.778M non-Look7 + 0.656 x modelled Look7 tris (0.656 = v49 Studio +0.606M / 0.924M edgefix4 modelled); LOD for instances >60 studs plan from H1 tee
